prompt_en:
Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: independent photographic render qualification
Input images: Image 1 is an adult_appearance_reference_no_identity_claim. Apply its visible adult appearance traits only to the designated central lead.

Create a complex photorealistic adult harem-romance ensemble scene in the rain-stalled glass-roof railway concourse after a nighttime arts festival. The central adult's visible appearance follows the supplied reference; Image 1 supplies adult appearance traits only for this lead: long dark wavy hair with a near-center part, dark eyes, softly defined natural makeup, and front-facing facial proportions. Under platform lamps and wet-glass reflections: one clearly adult person is the common target and compositional center of every bid, fully visible where the three separate approach paths converge. Across those paths: at least three separate clearly adult potential partners remain individually readable through distinct bodies, faces, hands, and approach paths; three clearly adult potential partners approach from separated paths at the same moment. In the same instant, each potential partner directs a different concrete invitation help offer or proposal to the same center: umbrella, hot drink with scarf, or replacement ticket with map. At the hub, the central adult visibly pauses sequences or manages the simultaneous incoming bids by raising one hand and controlling the overlapping handoffs. Meanwhile, cross-glances paused hands or spatial adjustments show that the partners notice the overlapping bids and actively make room around one another. The outcome remains visibly unresolved. Use an eye-level medium-wide editorial frame; keep every hand, face, prop, eyeline, and offer-to-center path readable. Let rainy concourse light wrap faces and objects, with drink steam and wet-floor reflections.

Avoid: 3D render look, fake-looking background, low resolution, warped product geometry, cartoon style, inaccurate reflections, illustration look, excessive HDR, over-processed retouching
